name: Create Coordinate Plane Activity
description:
An 8th grade math teacher needs a flipchart for a lesson on plotting ordered pairs. Create a 2-page ActivInspire flipchart saved as '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/coordinate_plane.flipchart'.

Page 1 - Title & Instructions:
- Title: 'Plotting Ordered Pairs'
- Instruction text must include the phrase 'coordinate plane'

Page 2 - Diagram:
- Draw a coordinate plane with two perpendicular lines for the x-axis and y-axis.
- Label the axes 'x' and 'y'.
- Label the four quadrants using Roman numerals (I, II, III, IV).
- Plot 5 specific points using small circles or dots and label them with their coordinates:
  1. (3, 4)
  2. (-2, 5)
  3. (-4, -3)
  4. (5, -2)
  5. (0, 0)

Ensure the file is saved correctly and all text labels are visible.
